# David Martínez — Backend Engineer

> I'm a freelance backend engineer building TypeScript and NestJS APIs, billing workflows, and search integrations for SaaS. Based in Honduras (CST), available 20–30 hrs/week for US and EU timezones.

I'm David Martínez (David Daniel Membreño Martínez). I build reliable, observable, fault-tolerant systems for SaaS teams. My focus is the engineering work that decides whether a SaaS scales past its first 1000 customers: reliability, idempotency, observability, and graceful failure.

## What I do

- **Backend APIs that scale**: Production-grade REST and GraphQL APIs with NestJS and Node.js. Multi-tenant, well-tested, observable.
- **Event-driven architecture**: Async workflows, the Outbox Pattern, idempotency, and retries with exponential backoff.
- **Production firefighting**: Race conditions, duplicate records, silent job failures, slow queries. I diagnose the bug and add the observability to catch the next one.

## My tech stack

- **Languages & Runtime**: TypeScript, Node.js, JavaScript
- **Backend & APIs**: NestJS, Express, GraphQL, REST, TypeORM
- **Data & Infra**: PostgreSQL, Redis, Convex, Docker
- **Architecture**: Event-driven, Microservices, Outbox Pattern, Multi-tenant
- **Observability & Testing**: OpenTelemetry, Pino, Jest

## Selected work

- **Cerebro — External SEO and Search Console** (2026). I built public-page audits, linked verified Search Console properties, and added indexing diagnostics and saved Claude research grounded in public sources.
- **GraphxSource — Reliable Orders and Billing** (2026). I implemented payment method response replay on retries, subscriber-scoped deletions, corrected weekly quota reconciliation, and improved logging for order idempotency conflicts.
- **iOBOT — Omnichannel CRM Backend** (2024, Authcode). I built event-driven workflows, real-time delivery with Socket.io, and an OpenAI chatbot layer for a CRM integrating WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger.
